title: #387 Balance and Media
prompt: Are there practical solutions or guidelines for maintaining a healthy balance with social media?

promptSegments.text: Are there practical solutions or guidelines for maintaining a healthy balance with social media?

requirements.en: Answer every direct question in the prompt.

requirements.en: State a clear and consistent position when an opinion is requested.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first major reason is that people spend too much time online, which takes up many hours and prevents them from having time for hobbies or family time.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: One effective solution is to set clear time limits for social media use, which helps people focus on real-life activities during the day.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: One effective solution is to set clear time limits for social media use, which helps people focus on real-life activities during the day.

angles.label: Point 1

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: A practical solution is setting clear time limits to improve real-life engagement and well-being.

angles.label: Point 1
angles.en: The first major reason for poor digital habits is the inherent design of social media platforms, which is engineered to maximize user attention and time spent scrolling, leading individuals to neglect real-world responsibilities.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: The first major reason for poor digital habits is the inherent design of social media platforms, which is engineered to maximize user attention and time spent scrolling, leading individuals to neglect real-world responsibilities.

angles.label: Point 2
angles.en: An effective solution is promoting digital literacy and self-regulation, empowering users to take control of their feed by setting specific time limits and developing stronger self-control.
angles.vi: Góc nhìn: An effective solution is promoting digital literacy and self-regulation, empowering users to take control of their feed by setting specific time limits and developing stronger self-control.

promptTraps.en: Do not write off-topic generalizations; ground every point in the specific context of Media and communication.

promptTraps.en: Avoid memorized generic templates; ensure every body paragraph contains concrete reasoning and evidence.
promptTraps.vi: Tránh các câu rập khuôn học thuộc lòng; hãy đảm bảo mỗi thân bài đều có lập luận và dẫn chứng cụ thể.
